create_optimizer_adam: create an Adam optimizer with configurable learning rate, momentum decay rates, and Nesterov acceleration
create_optimizer_adamw: create an AdamW optimizer with decoupled weight decay regularization for better generalization
create_optimizer_sgd: create a stochastic gradient descent optimizer with optional momentum and Nesterov acceleration
create_optimizer_lamb: create a LAMB optimizer for large batch training with layer-wise adaptive learning rates
create_optimizer_rmsprop: create a flexible RMSProp optimizer with configurable centered mode, momentum, and bias correction
